latestVersion.changelog:
Image to Online — Initial Release

- Launches the "Image to Online" skill: quickly convert images into 1080p shareable videos using simple prompts.
- Seamless onboarding: automatic cloud session setup with free anonymous tokens (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Supports uploading images, adding transitions/music, exporting high-quality MP4 and other formats in 30–90 seconds.
- All processing is cloud-based with no local installs or manual export settings required.
- Clear user prompt handling for actions like upload, export, credits balance, and timeline preview.
- Robust error handling for file types, credits, and session states.
